/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe use of " + call.getFunction().asExpr().(Name).getId() + " that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection via eval/exec with potentially untrusted input

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SQL injection
 * @description Building SQL queries from user-controlled sources can lead to SQL injection vulnerabilities
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/sql-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-089
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module SqlInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SqlExecution sql).getSql()
  }
}

module SqlInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SqlInjectionConfig>;
import SqlInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from SqlInjectionFlow::PathNode source, SqlInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where SqlInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "SQL query built from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: SQL injection via string formatting or concatenation in SQL queries

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded secrets
 * @description Hardcoded passwords, API keys, or other secrets in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Assign assign, string var_name, StrConst secret_value
where
  exists(Name target |
    target = assign.getATarget() and
    var_name = target.getId() and
    (
      var_name.regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|passwd|pwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|private[_-]?key|access[_-]?key).*")
    ) and
    secret_value = assign.getValue() and
    secret_value.getText().length() > 8 and
    not secret_value.getText().regexpMatch("(?i).*(example|test|dummy|fake|placeholder|your_|insert_|change_me|todo).*")
  )
select assign, "Potential hardcoded secret in variable '" + var_name + "'."
findings.hypothesis: Hardcoded passwords, API keys, or other secrets in source code
